theater: 伊斯帕尼奧拉島北部與南部

battle.name: 海地王朝的建立
battle.theater: 伊斯帕尼奧拉島北部與南部
battle.brief: 戰爭列表在公元前1732年名下收錄「海地王朝的建立」，但伊斯帕尼奧拉島在該年代既無文字亦無國家，可考的王朝建立實在1804年至1820年間：德薩林稱帝、克里斯托夫加冕。卡面埃及長矛屬青銅時代工藝，島上近戰武器則是削尖木桿與黑曜石刃木棒。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰方在史籍中只能從兩端確認。中段，即公元前1732年前後，並不存在可辨的交戰方：伊斯帕尼奧拉島當時仍屬前陶期的採集、狩獵群體，考古遺址集中於海岸貝丘與岩棚，沒有城垣、沒有文字、沒有金屬、沒有常備武力，「王朝」一詞只能視為後世對早期政治秩序的臆測，或者年代錯置。真正與「海地王朝的建立」相對應而有完整記錄的交戰，是法屬聖多明各的殖民軍與被判為財產的非洲裔人口之間的戰爭，以及其後北方王國與南方共和派之間的內戰。一方是法國王國及其殖民體系：駐聖多明各的白人軍官團、巴黎派出的殖民地代表、以大莊園制為基礎的克里奧爾莊園主，以及1802年重新推行奴隸制的拿破崙政府；遠征軍由查爾斯·勒克萊爾率領，1803年由拉尚博接掌。另一方是1791年北部起義後成軍的黑軍，以及被奴役的大多數人口，起義軍吸納了自由有色人種與反對恢復奴隸制的克里奧爾白人。外國干涉把戰線拉成數條：1793至1798年英軍佔領北部，1793至1795年西班牙佔領中西部，英西聯軍在1794年圍困南部的雅克馬與熱內維耶夫。1804年之後，島內再分為北方亨利·克里斯托夫的君主國與南方亞歷山德·佩蒂翁的共和國，1811年的南部起義即此分裂的第一次大規模內戰。
countriesEn: The belligerents can only be identified from the two ends of the record. The middle, that is the neighbourhood of 1732 BC, offers no identifiable sides at all: Hispaniola was still occupied by pre-ceramic gathering and hunting communities, the archaeological sites clustering in coastal shell middens and rock shelters, with no ramparts, no writing, no metal and no standing force; the word dynasty can only be read either as a later guess at an early political order or as a misplaced date. What does correspond to the establishment of the Haitian dynasty, and what is fully documented, is the war between the colonial troops of French Saint-Domingue and the African population held as property, and then the civil war between the northern kingdom and the southern republic. On one side stood the French kingdom and its colonial apparatus: the white officer corps in Saint-Domingue, the representatives sent out from Paris, the Creole planters whose economy rested on the great plantation system, and the government of Napoleon Bonaparte, who restored slavery in 1802; the expedition was led by Charles Leclerc and taken over in 1803 by Rochambeau. On the other side stood the Black army formed after the rising in the north in 1791, together with the great majority of the enslaved population; the insurgents took in free people of colour and Creole whites who were opposed to the restoration of slavery. Foreign intervention stretched the front into several lines: British troops occupied the north from 1793 to 1798, Spain held the centre and west from 1793 to 1795, and the Anglo-Spanish combination besieged Jacmel and Jérémie in the south in 1794. After 1804 the island split once more, into the monarchy of Henri Christophe in the north and the republic of Alexandre Pétion in the south, and the southern rising of 1811 was the first large civil war born of that division.
people: 關鍵人物可分成島上、法方與干涉方三組。島上首先被記名的是剛果裔的杜蒂·布克曼與莊園趕車人讓·弗朗索瓦，1791年8月中旬在北部的布瓦·卡伊芒聚會被指為起義的策動者；另有被記為塞西爾·法蒂曼的婦女參與其列。1791年之後真正決定島上局勢的是前奴隸出身的杜桑·路維杜爾，他以騎兵軍官身分在1793年8月29日的薩凡·德·羅勒布瓦斯擊敗英軍，1794年之後轉向共和派並迫使西班牙於1795年退出，1798年驅走英軍，1798至1801年又與魯米耶等爭奪領導權，1802年6月7日在凱斯附近被法軍逮捕，1803年4月7日死於法國的汝拉要塞。讓-雅克·德薩林則是把勝利變成國家的那一位：他1802年在克雷特-阿皮羅擊退法軍，1803年11月18日的維爾蒂埃爾之役迫使法軍放棄攻勢，1804年1月1日在戈納伊夫宣布獨立，5月2日在海地角加冕為雅克一世，11月起下令清除境內法國人，1805年10月17日遇刺身亡。北方軍隊的總司令亨利·克里斯托夫在1804年11月奪取海地角，1808年擊敗佩蒂翁，1811年2月27日加冕為亨利一世並頒布王室憲法，1820年4月病逝；南方的老佩蒂翁於1803年病故，其子小佩蒂翁接掌南軍，1820年後成為統一後的總統。法方與干涉方的人物同樣關鍵：菲利普·德·波因西是1665年法屬聖多明各的奠基者；1802年遠征的指揮者勒克萊爾於1803年11月19日病逝，接手的拉尚博於同月18日同意撤退；下令恢復奴隸制的是拿破崙本人；1802年在西部登陸的英方由海軍上將海德率領，同年秋未能攻下海地角而撤走；巴黎方面的廢奴倡導者則有侯爵克萊蒙索內爾與格雷瓜爾神父。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into three groups: those of the island, those of France and those of the interveners. The first named on the island are the Congolese Dutty Boukman and the plantation driver Jean François, who were pointed to as the instigators of the rising at the Bois Caïman gathering in the middle of August 1791, together with a woman recorded as Cécile Fatiman. After 1791 the man who decided the fate of the island was Toussaint Louverture, a former slave who as a cavalry officer defeated the British at Savane de Rolleboise on 29 August 1793, turned to the republican side after 1794, forced Spain out in 1795, drove the British away in 1798, and then fought Roumier and the others for control between 1798 and 1801; the French took him prisoner near Les Cayes on 7 June 1802 and he died in the Fort de Joux in France on 7 April 1803. Jean-Jacques Dessalines was the one who turned victory into a state: he threw the French back at Crête-à-Pierrot in 1802, forced them to give up the offensive at the battle of Vertières on 18 November 1803, proclaimed independence at Gonaïves on 1 January 1804, was crowned Jacques I at Cap-Haïtien on 2 May, and from November ordered the removal of the French from the island; he was assassinated on 17 October 1805. Henri Christophe, commander of the northern army, took Cap-Haïtien in November 1804, defeated Pétion in 1808, was crowned Henri I on 27 February 1811 and issued a royal constitution, and died of illness in April 1820; the elder Pétion died of fever in 1803 and his son, the younger Pétion, took command of the southern army and, after 1820, became president of the reunited country. The French and foreign figures matter just as much: Philippe de Longvilliers de Poincy founded French Saint-Domingue in 1665; Charles Leclerc, who commanded the expedition of 1802, died of fever on 19 November 1803, and Rochambeau, who took over, agreed to withdraw on the 18th; the order to restore slavery was Napoleon's own; the British force that landed in the west in 1802 was under Admiral Hyde and withdrew in the autumn of that year without taking Cap-Haïtien; and the advocates of abolition in Paris were the Marquis de Clermonto-Tonnerre and the Abbé Grégoire.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛是青銅時代早期的工藝：木杆前端裝銅或青銅矛頭，形制簡潔，用途是守城垣與近身刺擊；它代表的是把刺擊武器金屬化的那一步，比公元前1732年早了一千五百年以上，而在海地這樣的島嶼上，金屬在歐洲人登陸之前從未出現。島上的近戰武器走的是另一條路線：泰諾人用的木棒前端綁上黑曜石刃，稱為「馬庫維特爾」，戰鬥與日常都用；刺擊靠削尖並以火烘硬的硬木桿，末端可裝骨或貝殼尖，狩獵與捕魚用弓矢，耕作用尖頭木鋤（「科阿」），同型工具至今在多米尼加與波多黎各地區仍可見，舟是獨木挖空的木舟，1492年12月5日哥倫布在島北岸記錄的長舟一次可載數十人划槳。至於1791至1804年雙方真正用於戰爭的兵器，則完全是另一個技術系統：起義的農民以榨糖蔗刀、木柄砍刀、削尖的短棍與莊園自備的燧發獵槍為主，島上自1791年起便有大量獵槍與手槍流入民間；法國遠征步兵裝備1777年式的燧發滑膛步槍與標準刺刀，野戰砲為四磅與十二磅級別，封鎖海地角港口靠的是艦隊火炮與攻城重砲；騎兵用一七九一年式馬槍，後勤靠騾子馱運與數十艘運輸船。真正能與卡面長矛相比的，是刺刀步槍——那正是金屬化刺擊武器在西半球的一次大規模移植；而島上原有的黑曜石刃木棒與蔗刀，本質上是以材料換鋒利，不是以鍛冶換鋒利。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is early Bronze Age work: a wooden shaft with a copper or bronze head fitted to the front, a plain form built for defending walls and for stabbing at close quarters. It represents the step of metallising the thrusting weapon, and it predates 1732 BC by more than fifteen centuries; in an island like Haiti, metal had never appeared before the Europeans landed. The island's close-combat weapons followed a different road: the Taíno club with obsidian blades lashed to a wooden head, the macuahuitl, served both in war and in daily life; thrusting was done with hardwood poles sharpened and fire-hardened, sometimes fitted with a bone or shell point; bows and arrows were for hunting and fishing; cultivation used a pointed wooden hoe, the coa, a tool of the same type that can still be seen in parts of the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico; and boats were dugouts, the long canoe that Columbus described off the north coast of the island on 5 December 1492 being rowed by several dozen men at a time. The arms actually used in the fighting of 1791 to 1804 belonged to a wholly different technological system: the insurgents were armed with the sugar-cane cutting knives of the plantations, wood-handled cutlasses, sharpened clubs and the flintlock hunting guns the estates kept, and a great many hunting guns and pistols had flowed into private hands on the island from 1791 onward; the French infantry of the expedition carried the 1777-pattern flintlock musket with a socket bayonet, their field guns were four- and twelve-pounder pieces, and the blockade of the port of Cap-Haïtien was carried out with naval guns and heavy siege pieces; the cavalry used the 1791-pattern carbine, and mules and several dozen transports moved the baggage. The only thing that really answers to the spear on the card is the bayonet, which is the large-scale transplantation of the metallised thrusting weapon into the western hemisphere; the obsidian-bladed club and the cane knife of the island were sharpness bought with material rather than with the forge.
tactics: 公元前1732年的海地沒有可考的戰術：前陶期聚落沒有城牆、沒有兵器作坊，武器的用途是狩獵與儀式而不是戰爭，所以「王朝建立」一節的戰術只能作類比說明。真正留下痕跡的是1791年之後的島上。1791年8月下旬，北部平原的莊園同時起火，攻擊者以蔗刀與獵槍武裝，奪取莊園的武器、糧食與榨糖廠的控制權，之後是長期的游擊與占據。1793至1794年局勢因英、西、法三方各自拉攏不同的起義派系而重組：1793年8月29日杜桑在薩凡·德·羅勒布瓦斯擊敗英軍，1794年英西聯軍曾把南部雅克馬與熱內維耶夫圍住，自由有色人種的民兵與黑軍在南部擋住聯軍，1795年西班牙退出，1798年英軍被逐出北部。1802至1803年的遠征戰術更清楚：法軍2月6日在莫勒灣登陸，2月8日由海軍陸戰隊攻入海地角，2月14日起以艦炮封鎖港口；其後分兵西線圍攻熱內維耶夫、南線進取太子港與雅克萊、中線攻克克雷特-阿皮羅與維爾蒂埃爾。島上軍隊的制法是縱隊作戰配合鄉村游擊：破壞道路與橋樑、襲擊掉隊的砲車與糧隊、避入中央山脈；乾季（12月至4月）是遠征軍唯一能快速推進的季節，雨季（5月至11月）土路泥濘、溪水暴漲，馬匹與重砲寸步難行，黃熱病與瘧疾隨之而來。1803年11月18日的維爾蒂埃爾之役中，德薩林在城郊的制高點逐次消耗已被反覆消耗的法軍，法軍當日同意撤退，次日勒克萊爾病逝。1804年之後的王朝期，1804年11月起的清剿以鎮壓為主，1806至1807年北方軍沿海岸線據點與南方軍在山區對峙，1807年克雷特-阿皮羅一役南方得手，1811年克里斯托夫加冕後推行強制耕作制度，1811至1815年南方起義蔓延，1815年北方一度南下，1816年南方廢奴並鞏固共和。
tacticsEn: There is no recoverable tactic for 1732 BC: the pre-ceramic settlements had no walls and no armoury, and the weapons were for hunting and ritual rather than for war, so the tactics of a dynasty's establishment there can only be given by analogy. What did leave traces is the island after 1791. In late August 1791 the plantations of the northern plain burned at the same moment, the attackers being armed with cane knives and hunting guns, taking the weapons, the food and the control of the mills, and the rising was followed by long months of harassment and of holding ground. Between 1793 and 1794 the situation was rearranged as Britain, Spain and France each drew different insurgent factions to themselves: on 29 August 1793 Toussaint beat the British at Savane de Rolleboise; in 1794 the Anglo-Spanish combination besieged Jacmel and Jérémie in the south, where the coloured militia and the Black troops held the invaders off; Spain withdrew in 1795 and the British were driven out of the north in 1798. The tactics of the expedition of 1802 and 1803 are clearer still: the French landed at Le Môle on 6 February, took Cap-Haïtien with marine infantry on the 8th and began to blockade the port with naval guns on the 14th; they then split their force, besieging Jérémie in the west, taking Port-au-Prince and Jacmel in the south and assaulting Crête-à-Pierrot and Vertières in the centre. The islanders fought in columns combined with village harassment: they cut roads and bridges, raided guns and provision wagons that had fallen behind, and took refuge in the central mountains. The dry season from December to April was the only time the expedition could move quickly; in the rains from May to November the dirt roads turned to mud and the streams ran high, horses and heavy guns could advance very little, and yellow fever and malaria came with them. At the battle of Vertières on 18 November 1803 Dessalines wore down an army that had already been worn down, on the heights above the town, and the French agreed to withdraw that day; Leclerc died of fever the next morning. After 1804 the crowned period began with a campaign of repression from November 1804, and between 1806 and 1807 the northern army, holding its points along the coast, faced the southern army in the mountains, with the south gaining the day at Crête-à-Pierrot in 1807; after his coronation in 1811 Christophe imposed a system of compulsory cultivation, the southern rising spread from 1811 to 1815, the north marched south in 1815, and the south abolished slavery in 1816 and consolidated the republic.
data: 這一條目的數字必須分兩層說。公元前1732年一層完全沒有可用數字：島上沒有軍隊、沒有城防、沒有文字記載，任何兵力與傷亡的數目都只能是想像。可考的一層自十八世紀後期開始。1789年法屬聖多明各人口約四十萬，其中被奴役的非洲裔約三十五萬，自由有色人種與白人合計僅數萬；島上有約五百座甘蔗莊園，革命前夕年產糖以數萬噸計，是法屬殖民地糖產的大宗；十八世紀後期法屬安的列斯每年自非洲運入的人口以萬人計，航程死亡率極高，史家常以接近一半的量級描述。1793至1798年間英軍佔據北部，1793至1795年西班牙佔據中西部，1794年法國國民公會廢除奴隸制，1798年英軍被逐出北部。1802年遠征的兵力常被估為二萬二千至三萬人，另有數十艘運輸船、騎兵與砲隊：2月6日登陸，2月8日攻入海地角，4月熱內維耶夫之圍延續約六十天，6月7日杜桑被捕，11月27日克雷特-阿皮羅失利，1803年11月18日維爾蒂埃爾之後法軍放棄攻勢，19日勒克萊爾病逝；法軍在島上因戰鬥與疾病死者以萬計，撤回法國者僅數千人。1804年11月開始的清剿造成上萬人死亡，各家史家估計從一萬餘到兩萬不等，說法分歧頗大，正因如此歐洲與美國一時拒絕承認海地。1811年北方王國的人口在戰亂與屠殺後估計不足二十萬，1816年南方廢奴，1825年英國承認海地，1838年法國與海地達成協議，支付一億五千萬法郎的賠償。島南北長約三百五十公里，寬約二百五十公里；海地角至太子港公路約一百五十公里，維爾蒂埃爾在海地角城郊。
dataEn: The figures for this entry have to be given on two levels. The level of 1732 BC simply has none: the island had no armies, no defences and no written record, and any number for men or losses would be invention. The documented level begins in the later eighteenth century. In 1789 French Saint-Domingue had a population of about four hundred thousand, of whom roughly three hundred and fifty thousand were enslaved Africans, while free people of colour and whites together numbered only a few tens of thousands; the island carried about five hundred sugar plantations, and the sugar output in the years before the revolution ran to tens of thousands of tons a year and made up the bulk of the French colonial sugar crop; in the later eighteenth century the French Antilles were importing population from Africa at a rate of several thousand a year, the death rate on the middle passage being extremely high, and historians usually describe it on the order of half. British troops held the north from 1793 to 1798, Spain held the centre and west from 1793 to 1795, the French National Convention abolished slavery in 1794, and the British were driven out of the north in June 1798. The expedition of 1802 is usually put at between twenty-two thousand and thirty thousand men, with several dozen transports, cavalry and artillery: landing on 6 February, entering Cap-Haïtien on the 8th, being held off for about sixty days before Jérémie in April, the capture of Toussaint on 7 June, the reverse at Crête-à-Pierrot on 27 November, and after Vertières on 18 November 1803 the French gave up the offensive, Leclerc dying of fever on the 19th; the French dead on the island, in battle and in sickness, ran into the thousands, and only a few thousand were brought home. The purge that began in November 1804 killed many thousands, estimates ranging from a little over ten thousand to twenty thousand and differing widely between authorities, which is exactly why Europe and the United States refused at first to recognise the new state. The population of the northern kingdom in 1811, after the fighting and the purges, is estimated at under two hundred thousand; the south abolished slavery in 1816; Britain recognised Haiti in 1825 and France came to terms with it in 1838, paying an indemnity of one hundred and fifty million francs. The island is about three hundred and fifty kilometres long and two hundred and fifty wide; the road from Cap-Haïtien to Port-au-Prince is about one hundred and fifty kilometres, and Vertières stands just outside the town of Cap-Haïtien.
cause: 名目與年代之間的矛盾必須先講清楚：戰爭列表把「海地王朝的建立」繫在公元前1732年，但海地在該年代並沒有國家、沒有王朝、沒有戰爭，島上的文字紀錄要到1492年才開始；與「海地王朝」相對應而有史可考的一次，是1791至1804年的革命戰爭與其後的加冕。譯名「海地」在英文裡與另一個古國名只差一個字母，轉譯時的訛誤無法排除，但無論按哪一種讀法，公元前1732年的海地都沒有王朝可建；因此本條目只能按「海地王朝的建立」的字面所指，即新秩序的建國過程來理解。制度上的起因在十八世紀的法國與其殖民地：糖業大莊園制需要大量非洲人口，莊園的刑罰制度在1762至1763年被雅克改革整頓過，殺死莊園主要以燒炭燒死；1789年之後廢奴的主張隨法國革命傳到殖民地，1791年制憲議會收到侯爵克萊蒙索內爾與格雷瓜爾神父的廢奴動議；1793年英軍佔領北部時曾向部分黑人軍官許諾土地，這段被利用又被拋棄的經歷，使「黑人自建政權」在島上第一次成為可以想像的選項。真正把衝突推向全面戰爭的是1802年：拿破崙在帝國恢復奴隸制，原本支持法國的自由有色人種與克里奧爾白人都因此幻滅，1794年以來白人和黑人在共和派旗幟下勉強維持的同盟瞬間瓦解，島上的勝負自此只能在島內決定。
causeEn: The contradiction between the name and the date has to be stated first. The list of wars dates the establishment of the Haitian dynasty to 1732 BC, but Haiti had no state, no dynasty and no war in that age, and the island's written history does not begin until 1492. The one event that answers to the Haitian dynasty and is documented is the revolutionary war of 1791 to 1804 and the coronations that followed it. The rendering Haiti differs by a single letter in English from the name of another ancient people, and a slip in translation cannot be excluded; but on either reading there was no dynasty in Haiti in 1732 BC to establish. The entry can therefore only be taken in its literal sense, the founding of a new order. The institutional causes lie in eighteenth-century France and its colonies: the great sugar plantations required a large African population, and the penal system of the estates was reformed in 1762 and 1763 by Jacquet, under which the killing of a master was done by burning him at the stake; after 1789 the demand for abolition travelled to the colonies with the French Revolution, and in 1791 the Constituent Assembly received the motion for abolition from the Marquis de Clermonto-Tonnerre and the Abbé Grégoire. When the British occupied the north in 1793 they promised land to some black officers; the fact that this promise was used and then thrown away was what made a government of their own thinkable on the island for the first time. What pushed the conflict into total war was 1802: Napoleon restored slavery in the empire, the free people of colour and the Creole whites who had supported France were disappointed in turn, the uneasy alliance of blacks and whites under the republican flag of 1794 dissolved at a stroke, and from then on the issue on the island could only be settled on the island.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是西半球第一個由被奴役者建立的國家：1804年1月1日之後，海地不再是法國的領地，這件事在歐洲與美洲引起的震動遠超過戰役本身。美國在1803年購入路易斯安那的辯論裡，奴隸制能否延伸到新領土成為核心議題；海地革命示範了廢奴的可能，直接催生美國1807年禁止輸入奴隸的法令與英國同年廢止大西洋奴隸貿易；1815年維也納體系之後，歐洲與美洲的奴隸制陸續退場，巴西的廢奴更遲到1888年。法國自身則在1794年廢奴、1802年復辟、1803年再敗之間被反覆拉扯，馬克思在《政治經濟學批判大綱》裡把海地革命稱為階級壓迫的歷史實驗，伏都信仰與海地克里奧語則成為被壓迫者在本土建立的替代文化秩序。島內的制度後果同樣深遠：1804年11月起的清剿殺掉大量法國人與外國海員，使英美立即拒絕承認並實施貿易禁運，1825年英國與1838年法國才先後承認，後者並以一億五千萬法郎的賠償換取外交承認；1811年的王室憲法以土地與耕作制度重建秩序，卻把前奴隸農民綁在嚴格的強制耕作與勞役上，1820年克里斯托夫一死，帝制隨即崩潰，共和重新取得合法性。1847年索盧克自稱皇帝，曾被拿破崙三世譏為在西半球找到了自己的叔叔；1867年美國以十五萬美元購入海地，因憲法的禁止條款而未獲批准，1888年美國出兵佔領，1915至1934年軍事統治，1929年卡科人對美軍的抵抗與其領袖佩拉爾特之死，構成這段歷史最黑暗的續章。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this war was the first state in the western hemisphere founded by the enslaved: after 1 January 1804 Haiti was no longer a French possession, and the shock of that fact ran far beyond the fighting itself. When the United States bought Louisiana in 1803, the question of whether slavery could extend into the new territory became the central issue of the debate; the Haitian revolution demonstrated that abolition was possible, and it helped produce the United States ban on the import of slaves in 1807 and the British abolition of the Atlantic slave trade in the same year; after the Vienna settlement of 1815 slavery retreated step by step across Europe and the Americas, Brazil not abolishing it until 1888. France itself was pulled back and forth between abolition in 1794, restoration in 1802 and defeat in 1803, and Marx called the Haitian revolution a historical experiment in class oppression in the Grundrisse; the Vodou religion and Haitian Creole became the alternative cultural order the oppressed built on their own ground. The domestic consequences inside the island were no less deep: the purge from November 1804 killed a large number of Frenchmen and foreign seamen, which led Britain and the United States to refuse recognition at once and to impose a commercial embargo, so that recognition came only in 1825 from Britain and in 1838 from France, the latter for an indemnity of one hundred and fifty million francs. The royal constitution of 1811 rebuilt an order of land and cultivation, but it tied the former slave peasants to strict compulsory cultivation and labour, and when Christophe died in 1820 the monarchy collapsed at once and the republic recovered its legitimacy. Soulouque's assumption of the imperial crown in 1847 was mocked by Napoleon III as finding an uncle in the western hemisphere; the United States bought Haiti in 1867 for fifteen thousand dollars, a purchase the constitutional prohibition prevented from being carried out, invaded in 1888, and ruled it militarily from 1915 to 1934, the resistance of the Cacos in 1929 and the death of their leader Charlemagne Péralte forming the darkest chapter of that sequel.
result: 結果要分階段看。1791年8月北部起義席捲全島，1793至1794年的三方混戰之後，1794年法國國民公會廢奴，1795年西班牙退出，1798年英軍離開北部，杜桑在1798至1801年的內戰中雖贏得權位卻未能建立穩定秩序。1802年法國恢復奴隸制的遠征是決定性的一役：2月6日登陸、2月8日佔海地角、4月熱內維耶夫久攻不下、6月7日杜桑被捕，遠征軍在黃熱病與游擊的雙重消耗下崩解，1803年11月18日維爾蒂埃爾一役後法軍放棄攻勢，19日勒克萊爾病逝，12月主力上船撤退，1804年1月1日德薩林在戈納伊夫宣布獨立並定1月1日為解放日。1804年5月2日他在海地角大校場加冕為雅克一世，改國號為海地，11月起下令清除境內法國人，這一舉動造成島上外國人大量死亡，也讓國際承認整整遲了二十餘年。1805年代表大會拒絕世襲王位，迫使他只稱皇帝；1811年2月27日克里斯托夫在海地角加冕為亨利一世並頒布王室憲法，北方王國由此成立，「王朝」一詞在指稱海地君主制時也就此定型；1811至1815年南方起義、1815年北方南下回擊、1816年南方廢奴、1820年克里斯托夫病逝後佩蒂翁當選，帝制最終只維持了九年，海地長期維持共和。
resultEn: The outcome has to be read in stages. The rising in the north in August 1791 swept the island; after the tangled three-way war of 1793 and 1794 the French National Convention abolished slavery in 1794, Spain withdrew in 1795, the British left the north in 1798, and although Toussaint won the civil war of 1798 to 1801 he established no stable order. The expedition of 1802, sent to restore slavery, was the decisive round: landing on 6 February, taking Cap-Haïtien on the 8th, being held off for months before Jérémie, losing Toussaint on 7 June, and then dissolving under the combined pressure of yellow fever and harassment, the French abandoned the offensive after Vertières on 18 November 1803, Leclerc died of fever on the 19th, and the main body sailed away in December; on 1 January 1804 Dessalines proclaimed independence at Gonaïves and made the first of January the day of liberation. On 2 May 1804 he was crowned Jacques I on the Champ de Mars at Cap-Haïtien, renamed the country Haiti, and from November ordered the removal of the French from the island, a step that killed a great many foreigners on the island and delayed international recognition by more than twenty years. The assembly of representatives refused a hereditary crown in 1805 and left him with the title of emperor; on 27 February 1811 Christophe was crowned Henri I at Cap-Haïtien and issued a royal constitution, the northern kingdom was thereby established, and the word dynasty fixed itself as the usual term for Haitian monarchy; the southern rising of 1811 to 1815, the northern counter-offensive of 1815, the abolition of slavery in the south in 1816 and the election of Pétion after Christophe's death in 1820 ended the matter, the imperial experiment having lasted nine years, and Haiti remained a republic.
